name: Smithery
description: MCP server registry and gateway with managed OAuth and persistence.
descriptionZh: MCP 服务器注册表与网关，提供托管 OAuth 与持久连接。
keyFact: Smithery is a registry and gateway for MCP servers and agent skills that handles hosted OAuth and persistent connections; the service itself is proprietary, while its CLI at smithery-ai/cli is AGPL-3.0.
keyFactZh: Smithery 是 MCP 服务器与 Agent skills 的注册表兼网关，提供托管 OAuth 与持久连接；服务本身为专有，其 CLI（smithery-ai/cli）为 AGPL-3.0。
caveat: A claim that Smithery was acquired by Arcade.dev in August 2026 had only a single source and is unverified.
caveatZh: 关于 Smithery 于 2026 年 8 月被 Arcade.dev 收购的说法仅有单一来源，未获证实。
